subject: CSA: claim curation governance and evidence gate - initial intake
messages:

Cc: security-team@azurebank.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ intake + preferred evidence handoff

Hi Soojin,

We're starting a CSA/CAIQ review as part of our vendor security intake. Can you confirm the following so we can schedule our reviewer:

- Which CAIQ controls are you claiming (full crosswalk or subset)?
- Where will evidence live (upload link, access controls)?
- Who is the internal control owner we should contact for technical proof (logs, configs, keystore attestations)?
- Any required NDAs/DocuSign prior to shared logs?

We have a 2-week window to collect evidence; target kickoff the week of 7/5 if possible.

Thanks,
Elise
Elise Tran
Sr. Vendor Risk Analyst, AzureBank
[Audits Inc on behalf of AzureBank]

----
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Elise Tran <etran@azurebank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:04:12 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake + preferred evidence handoff

Thanks Elise — happy to scope this. Quick answers and proposed approach below.

Summary answers:
- Scope: We plan to provide a full CAIQ crosswalk for the standard CSA v4.1 baseline, with a focused sample of runtime telemetry/logs for controls marked as "evidence-required".
- Evidence location: we'll provision a time-limited GCP storage bucket and a Drive folder with explicit ACLs. We will also provide a shipped manifest (index) and a redaction summary for any PII.
- Owners: we'll nominate a control owner roster and a single technical liaison for the runtime samples.
- NDA/DocuSign: please send the DocuSign powerform link you require; we can sign and gate access on completion.

Proposed governance ("claim curation + evidence gate"):
1) Claim curation pass: internal SMEs validate which CAIQ questions we "affirmatively answer" vs "partial". We deliver a single CAIQ-Response workbook with column-level rationale and referenced artifacts.
2) Evidence gate: for controls marked "evidence-required" we stage artifacts behind an evidence gate — owners upload to our bucket, attach a short provenance note, and an appointed reviewer (security) approves release to the auditor.
3) Timeline: internal curation (3 business days); owner evidence collection (7 business days); auditor review window (5 business days).

I've attached a CAIQ-Response-Skeleton.xlsx and an evidence-gate-checklist.md to illustrate the manifest and the required provenance fields.

Next steps I propose:
- Confirm scope with you (full CAIQ vs partial),
- We will send a DocuSign powerform link for the auditor NDA,
- I'll loop in our control roster owners (cc'd Kimberly, Jonas) to start the curation pass tomorrow.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
